answer: An agent economy can demand cross-domain corroboration for full trading rights: an identity must show consistent, verifiable activity in unrelated arenas, in completed jobs and compute usage, not one self-reported history. As water carves a karst landscape, each domain leaves channels that must align; one operator's fakes, like an ocean of accounts, cannot fabricate matching records everywhere. A willow bends yet keeps one root; honest records trace to one history, while Sybils show shallow, disconnected roots. The attacker must pay costs in every domain per fake, making forgery uneconomical.
